player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long Nim.
Mipela i amamas long kisim laspela samting i stap.
Long kila raun, chusim wanpela hap pile na rausim wanpela o moa samting long en.
Usim format '[pile quantity]', we pile em i index bilong pile na quantity em i nambar bilong samting long rausim.
Olsem, '[0 3]' rausim 3 samting long pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nogat format bilong go i stap. Usim '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Pleya {player_id}, Akson i no gut. Kolom {col} i go longwe na bodi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Namba bilong pail {pile_index} i go ausait long renj.
invalid_move.non_positive: Em i mas rausim wanpela samting.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Inap long harim {quantity} from paile {pile_index} (nogat {pile_count} i stap).

observation.removed_from_piles: Pleia {player_id} i pilai [{pile_index} {quantity}], i rausim {quantity} samting long pile {pile_index}.
